post.caption: Colleen Moore's dollhouse held real jewels. In 1928, silent film star Colleen Moore began her dream dollhouse. Her father first suggested the idea. The Fairy Castle is more than eight feet wide. It comes apart into 200 pieces. In Cinderella's drawing room, a gold chandelier hangs with real gems. A tiny cradle in the garden was made from her grandmother's jewelry. Silver knights at the great hall door came from Rudolph Valentino's collection. From 1935 to 1939, it toured stores to help children's charities. In 1949, she gave it to Chicago's Museum of Science and Industry.
